card.name: Topical skin product application instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation inside topical skin-product text, such as 'with', 'of', 'or', 'such' and commas. They come before waxing, laser or procedure terms and before retinoid or cream names.

modes.label: Before waxing or procedure terms
modes.description: Linking words after retinoid or skin-treatment wording that lead into waxing, laser or filler procedures.

modes.label: Inside procedure lists
modes.description: Commas, 'or' and 'facial' within lists of dermatologic procedures for anesthetic creams.

modes.description: Partial drug names or small connectors in combination topical products.
